descriptions.interaction: Prior VRTI Explorer offers search bar, common keywords and curated-question dropdown. Current generated templates are intermediate expert-facing scaffolds; integration of new templates into end-user interface is future.
descriptions.guidance: KG class/property-grounded question templates; expert curation produces interpretable exploratory entry questions; narrowed ontology input and few-shot examples.
descriptions.visualisation: Natural-language question dropdown; no new interactive graph/visualization implementation asserted.

descriptions.evaluation: Offline question-generation similarity benchmark plus two blinded historical-domain expert evaluators of one20-question set/model. Prior12participant exploration study discussed separately.
descriptions.scalability: VRTI over2.7million triples; schema-term input, no runtime/resource benchmark on full KG.

report_level_evaluation.design: Offline question-generation similarity benchmark plus two blinded historical-domain expert evaluators of one20-question set/model. Prior12participant exploration study discussed separately.
report_level_evaluation.tasks: Each expert rates40question templates for relevance,clarity,answerability on1–5; selects preferred set and gives comments.
report_level_evaluation.comparators: GPT-4o vs Gemini2.0Flash question sets; expert-authored10ground-truth template questions for semantic similarity. Not a comparative end-user exploration task trial.
report_level_evaluation.measures: SentenceBERT all-mpnet-base-v2 maximum similarity, threshold.6; domain ratings and ICC(3,k).
report_level_evaluation.results: Highest semantic similarity GPT run6 .418, Gemini run11 .480; both experts prefer Gemini. Table3 overall means inconsistent with two listed rater means, so aggregate scores cannot be used as verified performance estimates. Relevance ICCGPT–.015/Gemini.144 with wide intervals. Prior12participants:3of4low-familiarity respondents preferred curated-question entry.; limits: Only2expert raters; low relevance agreement; overlapping prior/expert participants not established, do not sum to14.40rated questions/480generated questions are not people. Current method lacks end-user in-situ validation or executed SPARQL answerability; Table3 arithmetic/reporting inconsistency retained.
report_level_evaluation.limitations: Only2expert raters; low relevance agreement; overlapping prior/expert participants not established, do not sum to14.40rated questions/480generated questions are not people. Current method lacks end-user in-situ validation or executed SPARQL answerability; Table3 arithmetic/reporting inconsistency retained.
